E1.evidence: The reporter gives a reproducer with measurements on identical openni2/image_transport/compressed_depth_image_transport versions: on Kinetic "$ rostopic hz /camera/depth/image_raw/compressedDepth ... average rate: 3.953" versus on Indigo "average rate: 30.920" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/151).

units_identified: compressed_depth_image_transport (publisher plugin loaded by openni2_camera's image_transport::CameraPublisher)
E2.evidence: The documented effect is the CPU cost of PNG-encoding compressedDepth inside the publishing process, which slows that process for any subscriber: "When subscribing compressedDepth on kinetic, hz of image_raw drops. This is because load of CPU processing camera becomes too high. To avoid this on baxter-c1, png_level should be under 6. This behavior is different from indigo, so we should do further investigation..." (https://github.com/start-jsk/jsk_apc/pull/2706). The issue only asks "What is the cause of this difference?" and was closed on 2025-11-11 with no comment and no fix; no source identifies a value, name, unit or timing assumption that crosses a boundary between two named units. The package versions of image_transport (1.11.13) and compressed_depth_image_transport (1.9.5) are the same on both distros; only cv_bridge and OpenCV differ, and no source attributes the slowdown to either.

E3.evidence: No failing composition is identified; the report is a distro-to-distro performance comparison.

E4.evidence: Rate drop observed: Kinetic compressedDepth "average rate: 4.041" / "3.953" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/151).

ineligible_reason: internal: a performance difference in compressedDepth PNG encoding between Kinetic and Indigo whose cause was never identified (the issue is a question, closed in 2025 without answer or fix); the documented effect is encoding CPU load inside the publishing process that any subscriber would see. The only 'fix' (jsk_apc PR 2706) is a downstream workaround lowering the png_level parameter value in a launch file.
notes: Alternative reading considered: an UPGRADE of OpenCV (2.4.8 on Indigo, 3.3.1 on Kinetic) under compressed_depth_image_transport 1.9.5, or a rate_shortfall on topic /camera/depth/image_raw/compressedDepth. Neither is supported by any primary source: nobody attributes the slowdown to OpenCV, cv_bridge or libpng, and no interface element is named as mismatched. The linked ROS Answers thread (https://answers.ros.org/question/287421/) attributes low compressedDepth rates to the default compression: "The problem is related to the compressedDepth png compression level which is set by default to 9. We get 3-4 Hz in the default configuration." The jsk_apc workaround (merge commit 80715769fa99f0f1a524c92fb4cd63fa09a0f556) adds <param name="left/depth/image_raw/compressedDepth/png_level" value="5" /> to jsk_arc2017_baxter/launch/setup/include/stereo_astra_hand.launch and was tested only as a rate check ("This PR is already tested with real robot, by checking: $ rostopic hz ...").
